name: RAG Pipeline
shortDescription: Ask questions about your own documents: Qdrant, Ollama and a small ingest and query API
description:
A complete retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) stack that runs on your own machine or server. You upload text, Markdown or PDF files, and ask questions about them over HTTP. Answers come with the passages they are based on.

The stack has three services: **Qdrant** stores the document chunks as vectors, **Ollama** runs the embedding model (`nomic-embed-text` by default) and the chat model (`llama3.2:3b` by default), and **rag-api**, a small FastAPI service, splits documents into overlapping chunks, stores them in Qdrant and answers questions from the best-matching chunks (`POST /ingest`, `POST /query`, `GET /health`).

Everything stays local: no external AI API is called. Qdrant requires an API key, rag-api can require one, and all ports are published on 127.0.0.1 only. An optional override runs Ollama on an NVIDIA GPU.
requirements: Docker Engine 25 or newer with the Docker Compose plugin
4 CPU cores and about 8 GB RAM for the default models (llama3.2:3b, nomic-embed-text); larger chat models need more
About 15 GB free disk: images about 9 GB (mostly Ollama), default models about 2.3 GB, plus your documents
Optional: NVIDIA GPU with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit for faster answers

envVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
envVariables.description: API key for Qdrant, used by rag-api and the Qdrant dashboard. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32.

envVariables.name: RAG_API_KEY
envVariables.description: API key clients send as X-API-Key or Bearer token. Empty disables authentication; set it for anything beyond local testing.

envVariables.name: EMBED_MODEL
envVariables.description: Ollama embedding model. Changing it needs a new QDRANT_COLLECTION because the vector size changes.

envVariables.name: CHAT_MODEL
envVariables.description: Ollama chat model that writes the answers.

envVariables.name: PULL_MODELS
envVariables.description: Pull missing models into Ollama when rag-api starts.

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
envVariables.description: How long Ollama keeps a model loaded after a request.

envVariables.name: QDRANT_COLLECTION
envVariables.description: Qdrant collection that stores the chunks.

envVariables.name: CHUNK_OVERLAP
envVariables.description: Overlap between neighbouring chunks in characters.

envVariables.name: TOP_K
envVariables.description: Number of chunks passed to the model per question.

envVariables.name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
envVariables.description: Maximum size of one uploaded file or JSON request in MB.

envVariables.name: LLM_TIMEOUT
envVariables.description: Seconds to wait for Ollama; CPU inference can be slow.

envVariables.name: RAG_API_BIND
envVariables.description: Host address rag-api is published on. Use 0.0.0.0 only behind a firewall or TLS proxy.

envVariables.name: QDRANT_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port for the Qdrant REST API and dashboard (127.0.0.1 only).

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port for Ollama (127.0.0.1 only, no authentication).

envVariables.name: RAG_API_VERSION
envVariables.description: Tag of ghcr.io/aisolutionscamp/rag-api, also used for the local build.
